1.title: New Beginnings & Action
1.description: This is a year of new starts, independence, and high energy. It's the perfect time to plant seeds for the next 9-year cycle. Take initiative and trust your instincts.

2.title: Balance & Cooperation
2.description: A year to focus on relationships, patience, and diplomacy. It's a time to wait for seeds planted in Year 1 to germinate. Collaboration is key.

3.title: Creativity & Self-Expression
3.description: A fun, social, and creative year. Express yourself through art, writing, or speaking. Enjoy life, but be careful not to scatter your energy too much.

4.title: Hard Work & Foundation
4.description: This year is about building a solid foundation. Focus on work, organization, and practical matters. It might feel restrictive, but the effort will pay off.

5.title: Change & Freedom
5.description: Expect the unexpected! This is a dynamic year of change, travel, and freedom. Embrace flexibility and be open to new opportunities.

6.title: Responsibility & Family
6.description: Focus shifts to home, family, and domestic responsibilities. It's a year for nurturing relationships, marriage, or settling down.

7.title: Introspection & Spirituality
7.description: A quiet year for self-reflection, study, and spiritual growth. You might feel the need to withdraw socially to understand your deeper purpose.

8.title: Power & Achievement
8.description: A year of harvest. Focus on career, finances, and material success. You will reap what you have sown in the previous years. Step into your power.

9.title: Completion & Letting Go
9.description: The end of a cycle. It's time to finish projects, let go of what no longer serves you, and prepare for the new cycle. Clean the slate.
